title: Rain-Soaked Neon Street Portrait
promptText: Transform the provided reference photo into a cinematic rain-soaked neon street portrait while preserving the exact identity and recognizable facial characteristics of the person in the reference image. Dress the subject in a premium contemporary oversized charcoal-black bomber jacket layered over a minimalist dark graphite t-shirt, relaxed tailored black trousers, and understated black leather sneakers. All lighting must interact realistically with the person's skin, wet hair, clothing, rain droplets, and surrounding surfaces. Avoid excessive skin retouching, artificial beauty filters, plastic skin, or unrealistic facial enhancement. Keep the person's face sharply detailed while allowing the surrounding city environment to gradually fall into atmospheric cinematic blur. Compose the image as a premium vertical fashion editorial photograph with the subject occupying the visual center while maintaining sufficient environmental space around the body to communicate the rainy nighttime atmosphere. Use layered foreground reflections, midground rain and subject separation, and a softly blurred metropolitan background to create strong photographic depth. Apply a sophisticated cinematic color grade based on deep charcoal blacks, cool teal, cyan, subtle violet, restrained magenta, and controlled warm amber highlights. Maintain realistic skin tones despite the colored environmental lighting. Use high dynamic range, rich shadow detail, natural highlight transitions, realistic reflections and refractions, physically accurate rain behavior, subtle film grain, refined contrast, atmospheric depth, premium editorial color grading, and authentic photographic texture. The final image should feel like a luxury international streetwear campaign photographed during a rainy midnight city walk — stylish, emotional, mysterious, contemporary, and completely believable as a real photograph.
